FIFA Awards 2031 Women's World Cup to US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica

FIFA has awarded the hosting rights for the 2031 Women's World Cup to the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica. This bid was the sole candidacy for the 2031 edition. The tournament is set to expand to 48 teams for the first time in 2031. Additionally, the United Kingdom will host the Women's World Cup in 2035.
